info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Oracle WebLogic Server…
info.description:
RESTful API for deploying, undeploying, redeploying, and managing applications and shared libraries on Oracle WebLogic Server. Supports uploading application archives, deploying from the server file system, managing deployment plans, and controlling application lifecycle states across servers and clusters.

Contact Support:
 Name: Oracle Support

Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Start an edit session

request.description: Starts a new configuration edit session. Only one edit session can be active per user. The edit session locks the domain configuration for exclusive modification by the current user.

request.description: Activates all pending configuration changes made during the current edit session. This distributes changes to all affected servers in the domain.
